verdict.rationale: Fireworks is an inference and fine-tuning platform. The only in-product, AI-driven guidance in evidence is a guided path where you describe a task, then review a proposed plan and cost before approving a training run. That is a thin form of AI-generated suggestions; the rest of the pack covers developer APIs (tool calling, structured outputs) for building your own apps, not in-product insights. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights over the user's own data (usage, datasets, evals) inside the product, documentation of what the guided path analyzes or suggests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
